textbookBox.concept: Pressure is the force acting on a unit area: pressure = force ÷ area.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Pressure is the force acting on a unit area: pressure = force ÷ area.
beats.speakEn: Pressure is the force acting on a unit area: pressure  equals  force  divided by  area.

beats.en: For the same force, a smaller area gives a larger pressure, so thin straps hurt more than wide straps.
beats.speakEn: For the same force, a smaller area gives a larger pressure, so thin straps hurt more than wide straps.
